# Codex Discord Rich Presence

> Unofficial Windows tray application for showing observable Codex CLI and Codex Desktop activity in Discord Rich Presence.

## Canonical links

- Website: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/
- Source: https://github.com/k153636/codex-discord-presence
- Latest release: https://github.com/k153636/codex-discord-presence/releases/latest
- FAQ: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/faq.html
- Compatibility: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/compatibility.html
- Data flow: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/privacy.html

## Product facts

- Product type: local Windows tray application.
- Supported published target: Windows x64.
- Current runtime requirement: .NET 9 Desktop Runtime.
- Discord requirement: Discord Desktop must be running for local Rich Presence delivery.
- Supported profiles: Codex Desktop and a separate Codex CLI profile.
- Main output: one readable Discord activity line with configured details, state, assets, timestamps, and buttons.
- Activity evidence: structured Codex session events and direct tool targets take precedence over fallback file and timestamp evidence.
- MCP behavior: a current MCP operation can replace the normal reasoning, file, or command label with the active server identity.
- Local inputs: Codex session JSONL, Codex configuration, process/window signals, project metadata, and Git metadata according to configuration.
- Hosted service: none operated by this project.
- Affiliation: unofficial community project; not endorsed by OpenAI or Discord.

## Important limits

- macOS and Linux binaries are not promised by the current release.
- The app does not provide a hosted team dashboard or guaranteed live quota data for every plan.
- Configured activity text can expose project names, file labels, or reasoning summaries to Discord.

## Installation

Download `discord-presence-for-codex.exe` from the latest GitHub Release and run it on Windows x64 with the .NET 9 Desktop Runtime installed.
